title: Chapter 392
text:
Glancing at everyone's expectant eyes, Han Xiao opened the faction interface and put in the Sunil NCO Class armor, as well as some low-level machinery blueprints that he did not need previously.

The blueprints were only suitable for Mechanics, mainly because the NCO Class armor was easier to sell. The players had earned extra repair and enhancement fees from the Enlistee Class armor last time, so the players would not be stingy with the NCO Class armor now.

There were three types of Sunil armor — assault, defense, and reconnaissance. The NCO Class armor had all been enhanced. On average, the armor was three times higher than the Enlistee Class armor, and the total attribute bonus was 15 points more. The bonus for melee combat was 20 points, and there were also new accessories. The reconnaissance type moved very fast, jumping high and far, and the chainsaw wrist blade could be ejected from the arm, so it was not afraid of melee combat. The defense type was equipped with heavy firepower, leaning toward long-range combat. It held a large caliber cannon and armor-piercing gunpowder bullets. The gun could be folded in half, and the cannon was about the size of a person. Every time it fired, the gun flame was like an explosion of smoke, and the bullets were like small burning meteors. The shooting speed was very fast, and the gunshots were like drums. The ammunition capacity was 250 rounds, and it came with many extra clips. The assault type had the advantages of both, and it was more comprehensive.

Previously, Li Ge had used the Secret Message Bead to exchange for the NCO Class armor, which was a reconnaissance type. The others knew the attributes of the equipment, and they were all envious. Now that the faction store was updated, they were all energized and rushed to buy it without any introduction.

He set the price at 1,400 Enas, and he also set the Reputation cost, which was 1,000 Reputation. He set the Favorability range from 0 to 1,000, and 50 Enas could be exchanged for 100 Faction Reputation. The players had spent 500 Reputation to buy the Enlistee Class armor last time, and after this mission, Han Xiao rewarded them with another 300 Reputation. In other words, the real cost of buying the NCO Class armor was 1,750 Enas.

The players had received about 5,000 Enas from the Silvers, and this would cost them one-third of it. However, the players did not hesitate. Professional players earned money to buy equipment and increase their combat ability as much as possible.

There were seven NCO Class armors in the inventory, and the rest were pre-sold. The players were used to it and never doubted the credibility of the faction. The first seven people to purchase it received the real thing. The gray metal was thick and tough, with sharp edges and corners. It gave off a strong smell of steel. The silent combat weapon had a unique charm.

Mad Blade snatched one of them and quickly put it on. Finally, he put on the helmet and turned it into the combat analysis field of vision that came with the helmet. Everything he saw was marked by a database. At this moment, a mechanical voice sounded from inside the helmet.

"Welcome to the Black Star Armor. Your serial number is HA0001. Undergoing automatic inspection. Completion of inspection. Armor status: 100. Hydraulic power in good condition. Weapon system in good condition. Ejection system in good condition. User's vital signs normal."

Mad Blade tried to move his arms and legs, and the sound of mechanical parts moving could be heard. With the addition of power, his fists buzzed and buzzed.

"This set of armor is much stronger than the Enlistee Class. I bought the reconnaissance type. It's very agile and works well with heavy weapons to reduce the impact of the heavy weight. I can fight more nimbly." Mad Blade was overjoyed.

He was a Mechanical Pugilist and used melee weapons most of the time. The NCO Class gave him the biggest boost.

The Mechanic class was the class with the highest armor buff. Players of other classes could also use it, and the effect was not bad. It increased defense, firepower, and a layer of HP. More importantly, it required the various functions of the armor. For example, a fragile Mage could wear a protective armor and fight mindlessly. This kind of mix and match made people feel strange and fun.

The Enlistee Class and NCO Class were standard armor. The stronger Sunil General Class was for Supers and had stronger attributes. He had not learned it yet.

As usual, Han Xiao held back when he created the armor, leaving room for improvement.

Other than the armor, the few Mechanic class players in the faction liked the new blueprints. Every time they gambled on blueprints, they were trembling with fear. Now that Han Xiao could directly learn many blueprints, they were overjoyed.

The blueprints that Han Xiao put up were naturally the unimportant but useful ones. He kept the important ones for himself and released the unimportant ones, which would be more effective.

Maple Moon's eyes were shining, and her cute face was filled with joy.

"Optical Disruption Trap, this is not bad. Sigh, that Scatter Cannon is not bad either."

Maple Moon could be considered a rather casual and cute girl, but she had also developed a calculative personality after being raised by the Mechanic class. A blueprint only cost three to four hundred Enas, which was much more cost-effective than gambling blueprints. She extended her finger and poked it, buying, buying, buying.

Han Xiao valued the Mechanic class players more. Not only was it easier to earn their money because they were of the same origin as him, but they could also become his helpers when they grew up, which might allow him to enter the next stage of the Mechanic class in advance.

The players of other classes naturally did not care about these blueprints. Only the NCO Class armor was to their liking.

However, selling things was not the main purpose of Han Xiao's trip. He gave everyone a large wave of faction missions that he had prepared long ago. The rewards were all Dungeon Crystals. He had cut out some of the later stages of the Germinal Organization to form a level 60 dungeon and the most recent battle: Power of the Dragon Emperor.

The Dungeon Crystals could only be used as mission rewards and could not be sold. However, the rules were dead, and people were alive. These mission rewards were Dungeon Crystals, and he planned to use them as repeat missions. There was only one completion condition, and that was to increase a certain amount of faction Reputation after accepting the mission.

He had set it as' increase 'and not' reach 'a certain value. For example, after accepting the mission and gaining 500 Reputation, one would be able to complete the battle: Power of the Dragon Emperor mission and obtain the Dungeon Crystal. The other low-value dungeon missions could also be completed at the same time, making the players feel that they had profited. This way, it would attract players to spend money to buy Reputation. Since one had spent money to buy Reputation, they would have to spend it eventually. Faction Reputation could only be used by Han Xiao, so it was perfect for attracting spending.

Furthermore, when one's Reputation exceeded 1,000, the cost of purchasing Reputation would increase. If one wanted more Dungeon Crystals, they would have to repeat the cycle of buying Reputation and spending money to buy Reputation. Although there were no new products sometimes, he had many additional services, such as repair, enhancement, and so on.

If one wanted to buy things from the start, these missions would be extra rewards and could be used as promotion. If one only wanted Dungeon Crystals, they would be able to attract spending.

In any case, there was only one purpose of these services. With him, one would never have to worry about not being able to spend money.

Han Xiao was very mischievous. He only released this mission after the players had bought the armor. He would not let them take it for free.

"Damn, a new mission that rewards Dungeon Crystals?"

"The requirement is to increase Reputation. Aiya, what a pity. If we had this mission just now, wouldn't we have completed it directly? What a waste."

"Actually, it doesn't matter. Anyway, we still have to enhance the armor and so on. Moreover, Black Star's Reputation will definitely come in handy in the future. It won't be a waste."

"Yo, there's a new Dungeon, Power of the Dragon Emperor. Isn't that what we experienced a few days ago? It turns out that the faction will not only update the equipment and products, but it will also turn our experience into a Dungeon Crystal."

Everyone was pleasantly surprised. As expected of a growth-type faction, they suddenly felt a sense of excitement. This was an unexpected surprise. After they had followed Black Star to the galaxy, they had never seen a Dungeon Crystal. They did not expect that this faction would have its own Dungeon Crystal. After experiencing more missions, there would be new Dungeons that they could choose.

Seeing this, Han Xiaoxin said, "Oh right, if a faction can provide a steady supply of Dungeons, this is also a form of attraction."

Everyone was most curious about the Dragon Emperor Dungeon. This was a new Dungeon that they had never seen before.

Among the crowd, Pork Bun saw the Battle Map: Power of the Dragon Emperor Dungeon. Suddenly, his heart skipped a beat, and his eyes gradually lit up.

"This Dungeon might be able to reproduce the scene from that time."

His heart thumped, and he immediately bought 500 Reputation. He touched the Dungeon Crystal nervously, and a message popped up on the interface.

Level 90 Dungeon Crystal Battle Map: Power of the Dragon Emperor

Introduction: At the border between the Holy Stone Civilization and the Black Raven Civilization in the Colton Star Cluster's Gavin Star System, a mercenary team was pursued by the Dark-star fleet. At the critical moment, the Dragon Emperor Ames descended. This will be your test.

Type: Time reversal Dungeon

Limit: 10 people

Current number of people who have passed: 0

Highest Dungeon Completion Rate: None

Record Holder: None

Everyone came over. When they saw the item introduction, they were all shocked.

"A level 90 Dungeon Crystal."

This has already exceeded our level limit.

The level of the Dungeon Crystal did not represent the entry threshold, but the recommended level of the challenge. Even a level 1 newbie could enter a level 60 Dungeon Crystal, but the result was obvious. Even if they could find a powerleveling team, the level difference between the monsters in the Dungeon Crystal was too large, and there would be a very high EXP penalty and rating penalty.

Fighting Dungeons could allow players to gain EXP and train their skills, but they would not be able to bring out the equipment from the Dungeon. However, after clearing the Dungeon, if the rating was high, they would be rewarded with a random item or equipment. These were the benefits of fighting Dungeons. There was a limit to the number of Dungeons that could be challenged, and they would be refreshed after a certain period of time. If one wanted to obtain top-grade equipment in Dungeons, one could forget about it at all if they did not get a top-grade rating. Up until now, players from various planets had challenged so many Dungeons, but the number of Dungeons that could produce reliable equipment or items could be counted on one hand. Moreover, the difficulty of those Dungeons was very high.

Not only them, none of the players had ever seen a level 90 Dungeon Crystal. Everyone was shocked that the Black Star Mercenary could give out such a high-level Dungeon Crystal.

Han Xiaoxin smiled inwardly, turned around, and left.

The NCO Grade armor, the blueprint, and the Dungeon Crystal mission. This trip has earned me a total of 98,000 Enas, which is close to 100,000 Enas. Adding the savings in my account, I have around 140,000 Enas. At the very least, I can buy three class advancement knowledges. Han Xiao was very satisfied.

After he left, the players in the base could not wait to form a team. They wanted to try out what a level 90 Dungeon Crystal felt like.

Pork Bun formed a team with Mad Blade, Maple Moon, and Hao Tian, three of whom he was familiar with. Together with the players from Long Sky and the other clubs, they had a total of ten people.

He crushed the Dungeon Crystal, spat out a cloud of mist, and enveloped everyone. They entered the Dungeon Crystal immediately.

The world in front of them changed. Pork Bun and the others suddenly could not control their bodies. Their perspective was pulled up, and they looked down at a very familiar planet. It was Fawn Planet 122 where the chase happened.

They saw the Silvers' spaceship take off and suddenly explode. The Dark-star mothership appeared, and then it sent out a large number of hovering ships to chase after the three mercenary spaceships. This was exactly what they had experienced. However, they were all on the spaceship at that time. Now, they were seeing everything from the perspective of a third person. It was a completely different experience.

"This is a cutscene animation," Hao Tian said in the channel. She was very experienced.

Many Dungeons had cutscenes, so everyone was not surprised. They just stared at it without blinking.

The enormous DarkStar mothership was being chased by a dense hovering fleet, and the three mercenary spaceships were running for their lives. It was a very impactful scene. Then, they saw the Sky Ring spaceship suddenly accelerate, and its flight path became extremely erratic. The hovering fleet behind it was being led around like a dog being walked.

"Wow, this is even better than drunk driving."

"I remember that Black Phantom was the one driving the spaceship. No wonder the people on the spaceship were so dizzy." Mad Blade still had some lingering fear.

The cutscene was about three minutes long. This was a copied scene created by the Dungeon Crystal and not the real thing. It condensed the development of the events and changed it. The mercenary spaceships entering the underground and the alliance fleet arriving at the same time happened.

The cutscene ended there. As the captain, Hao Tian received a notification.

The Dungeon Crystal is about to begin. Please choose a faction to participate in.

Note: The faction you choose will affect the Dungeon Completion Goal and Difficulty

Fugitive Mercenary: Your mission is to escape from the pursuit and hold on until the Dragon Emperor arrives.

Dark-star Pursuer: Your mission is to capture a certain number of mercenaries before the Dragon Emperor arrives.
